name: smitline
description: Make phone calls and join Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet meetings from any AI agent. A self-hosted voice agent.
long_description: Smitline gives your AI agent a phone line and a seat in your meetings. It makes phone calls (restaurants, offices, plumbers, friends) through your own SignalWire or Twilio number, joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Google Meet meetings as a meeting bot that listens and answers when spoken to, says it is an AI, talks in real time with OpenAI GPT-Live, and returns a structured result: the outcome, details such as times and prices, decisions, action items, the transcript and the cost. Smitline runs on your computer in Docker with your own keys; this bundle connects your MCP client to it. Set it up first: https://github.com/kaelorlabs/smitline#readme

token.title: Smitline MCP token
token.description: Printed by: docker exec smitline smitline setup register --json. Without it the tools are listed, and calls say how to connect.
